axes_source: Read from data/brands/airtable.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #181D26 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #181D26 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #181D26; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 2, 6, 10, 12px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #181D26 reaches 16.90:1 on the canvas #FFFFFF, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
